name: Indoor Environmental Quality: Theory and Practice
description: The course will provide students with a foundational understanding of indoor environmental quality (IEQ). It will cover key factors affecting IEQ, including temperature, humidity, ventilation, lighting, noise, and air quality. Students will learn about methods for measuring, assessing, and controlling these parameters. The course will also explore bioaerosols in indoor environments, relevant standards and guidelines, as well as case studies and best practices in indoor air quality (IAQ) management.
